label: Pathfinder 2e
description: Pathfinder Second Edition — complete catalog of ancestries, heritages, versatile heritages, classes, and class specializations according to Remaster (Player Core 1 & 2) and expansion rulesets.
edition: Player Core / Player Core 2 / Complete Expansions
tldr: Pathfinder 2e is a mathematically tight fantasy RPG built around three actions per turn, four degrees of success, proficiency ranks, and extensive character customization.

Acolyte.description: You spent time in a temple or cloister serving a deity.

Acrobat.description: You trained in gymnastics, tumbling, and aerial performances.

Animal Whisperer.description: You have a natural affinity for training and handling animals.

Artisan.description: You spent years learning a trade, crafting goods for a living.

Barkeep.description: You ran or worked in a tavern, learning how to talk to anyone.

Barrister.description: You studied laws, contracts, and legal precedent.

Emissary.description: You represented a ruler, nation, or organization in diplomatic matters.

Entertainer.description: You captivated crowds with music, acting, or storytelling.

Farmhand.description: You worked long hours on farms doing heavy manual labor.

Gladiator.description: You fought in arenas for the amusement of spectators.

Guard.description: You served as a city watchman, caravan guard, or gatekeeper.

Hermit.description: You lived away from civilization, finding peace or hardship in solitude.

Hunter.description: You tracked and hunted wild beasts for food, pelts, or sport.

Laborer.description: You performed grueling physical labor in construction or mining.

Merchant.description: You bought and sold goods, navigating trade routes and markets.

Noble.description: You were born into a ruling family with wealth, status, and responsibilities.

Nomad.description: You traveled constantly across wild lands without a permanent home.

Sailor.description: You spent your life on the open water navigating ships and battling storms.

Scholar.description: You spent years reading tomes and researching academic topics.

Scout.description: You guided groups through dangerous wilderness and spotted threats.

Street Urchin.description: You grew up orphaned or poor, surviving on city streets.

Warrior.description: You trained for war and fought on battlefields.

alignment.description: Replaced by Holy/Unholy sanctification traits in Remaster rules.
